stem.text: Which molecule has the largest overall dipole?

A.alt: CH2=C(CH3)2 displayed formula: C=C with two H atoms on the left carbon and two CH3 groups on the right carbon

B.alt: (CH3)2C=O displayed formula: C=O with a CH3 group drawn above and a CH3 group drawn below the carbon

C.alt: Cl2C=O displayed formula: C=O with a Cl atom drawn above and a Cl atom drawn below the carbon

D.alt: CH3CCl=CClCH3 displayed formula: C=C with CH3 (upper left) and Cl (lower left) on the left carbon, Cl (upper right) and CH3 (lower right) on the right carbon
